license_required.quote: It is unlawful for a person to profess to be a podiatrist, to practice or assume the duties incident to podiatry or to advertise in any form or hold himself out to the public as a podiatrist

issuing_authority.quote: without first obtaining from the board a license authorizing the practice of podiatry in this state under this act

degree_required.value: Graduate of a school of podiatry requiring at least four years of instruction and 3,360 scholastic hours, plus two years of liberal arts or sciences
degree_required.quote: he has satisfactorily completed two (2) years in a recognized college of liberal arts or of the sciences, and that he is a graduate of a regularly established school of podiatry recognized by the American Podiatric Medical Association or its successor and the board which requires as a prerequisite to graduation the completion of at least three thousand three hundred sixty (3,360) scholastic hours of classroom work

accrediting_body.quote: a regularly established school of podiatry recognized by the American Podiatric Medical Association or its successor and the board

required.quote: Every applicant for a license to practice podiatry shall have successfully completed a residency approved by the board through rules and regulations.

kind.quote: successfully completed a residency approved by the board through rules and regulations

exams.name: Board examination (clinical and written)
exams.notes: Minimum passing grade of 75% average and not less than 60% in any one subject
exams.quote: the applicant must pass a satisfactory examination as prepared under the rules and regulations of the board

interval_years.quote: A renewal license fee in an amount established by the board pursuant to W.S. 33-1-201 shall be due to the board annually on July 1 each year

required.quote: Application for renewal shall be accompanied by evidence satisfactory to the board of compliance with participation in continuing education activities as established by rules and regulations of the board.

period_years.quote: The board shall require three (3) hours of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances every two (2) years.

value: 3 hours responsible prescribing of controlled substances every 2 years
topical_requirements.quote: The board shall require three (3) hours of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances every two (2) years.

available.quote: The applicant may be registered and given a certificate or registration and license if he presents satisfactory proof of the endorsement from his state board of having practiced podiatry

requirements.value: Must present endorsement from state board, hold a certificate or license issued at least one year prior to application, the issuing state must have equivalent requirements and reciprocal privileges with Wyoming, and applicant must have passed that state's clinical podiatry examination.
requirements.quote: the possession of a certificate of podiatry qualification or license issued to the applicant at least one (1) year prior to filing of application for reciprocal privileges

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for a person to profess to be a podiatrist, to practice or assume the duties incident to podiatry

title_protection.quote: It is unlawful for a person to profess to be a podiatrist ... or in a sign or advertisement to use the word "podiatrist", "foot correctionist", "foot expert", "foot specialist", "chiropodist" or any other term or designation indicating to the public that he is holding himself out as a podiatrist

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for a person to ... practice or assume the duties incident to podiatry ... without first obtaining from the board a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license by fraudulent representation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a license by fraudulent representation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of untruthful or improbable statements to patients or in advertisements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of untruthful or improbable statements to patients or in his advertisements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Alcoholism or habitual use of controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Alcoholism or habitual use of controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling or giving away alcohol or controlled substances for illegal purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Selling or giving away alcohol or controlled substances for illegal purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish evidence of satisfying continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish evidence showing the satisfaction of the requirements of continuing education required by the board

definition_quote.value: Podiatry means the diagnosis or the medical, mechanical or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, ankle and tendons that insert into the foot.
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatry" means the diagnosis or the medical, mechanical or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, ankle and tendons that insert into the foot.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis or the medical, mechanical or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, ankle and tendons that insert into the foot

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists are permitted to use and to prescribe drugs and controlled substances as may be necessary in the practice of podiatry.
drug_authority.quote: Podiatrists are permitted to use and to prescribe drugs and controlled substances as may be necessary in the practice of podiatry.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the diagnosis or the medical, mechanical or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, ankle and tendons that insert into the foot

amputation_authorized.quote: The practice of podiatric medicine shall include the amputation of the toes or other parts of the foot but shall not include the amputation of the foot or leg in its entirety.

anesthesia_authority.quote: A podiatrist may not administer any anesthetic other than local.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: Surgical treatment of the ankle and tendons that insert into the foot shall be limited to licensed podiatrists who have completed a podiatric surgical residency training program as approved by the board through rule and regulation.

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: Surgical treatment of the ankle and tendons that insert into the foot shall be limited to licensed podiatrists who have completed a podiatric surgical residency training program as approved by the board through rule and regulation.

xray_technician_certification_required.quote: Any person employed by or assisting a podiatrist licensed under this chapter shall ... successfully complete minimum safety education and training requirements specified under this section prior to operating any machine source of ionizing radiation

controlled_substances_prescribing_ce_req.quote: The board shall require three (3) hours of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances every two (2) years.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: This act shall not prohibit the fitting, recommending, advertising, adjusting or sale of corrective shoes, arch supports or similar mechanical appliances or foot remedies by retail dealers or manufacturers.
